title: NCAA: Valencia’s heroics steer Arellano past San Beda to snap skid
summary: After squandering a 15-point lead and losing T-Mc Ongotan to an apparent right ankle injury, Basti Valencia put on his superhero cape to steer Arellano University back into the win column.
